title.en: Which building line is the Electric 30 aggregate-13 row?
title.zh: 电动30的13骨料行对应哪段建筑管路？

description.en: Aggregate 13 on Electric 30 is the short pair: 20 m horizontal / 60 m vertical, not the fine-stone 60 m / 180 m. Maximum aggregate on the page is ≤ 3 cm.
description.zh: 电动30的13骨料是短的那一对：水平 20 m / 垂直 60 m，不是细石的 60 m / 180 m。该页最大骨料是 ≤ 3 cm。

h1.en: Which building line is the Electric 30 aggregate-13 row?
h1.zh: 电动30的13骨料行对应哪段建筑管路？

directAnswer.en: It is the shorter printed line on the same Electric 30 page from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai: 20 m horizontal and 60 m vertical, at 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa, with maximum aggregate ≤ 3 cm. The fine-stone line on that page is 60 m / 180 m. A building pour that needs the longer fine-stone numbers must actually be fine stone.
directAnswer.zh: 它是邢台河北品锦机械电动30同一页上较短的那一行：水平 20 m、垂直 60 m，功率 30 kW、输送量 12–15 m³/h、压力 20 MPa，最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm。同一页的细石行是 60 m / 180 m。建筑浇筑若要用更长的细石数字，料必须真是细石。

heading.en: How do you tell the two rows apart on site?

body.en: Ask for the mix name the batch uses, not a floor count. If the stone is the 13-aggregate description, the distance budget is 20 m horizontal and 60 m vertical. Hopper volume is 0.3 m³ and the unit weight is 1200 kg. Those cells do not change between the two distance rows.
body.zh: 问搅拌侧用的料名，不要问层数。石子属于 13 骨料描述时，距离预算是水平 20 m、垂直 60 m。料斗 0.3 m³，整机 1200 kg。这两个格子不因距离行而改变。

heading.en: Which other building pumps print a 13 mm or aggregate-13 row?
heading.zh: 还有哪些建筑泵印了 13 mm 或 13 骨料行？

body.en: Electric 40 prints aggregate 13 at 40 m / 120 m beside fine stone 120 m / 360 m. Electric 50 prints 13 mm stone at 80 m / 240 m beside fine stone 150 m / 350 m. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 13 mm at 100 m / 300 m. Those are different tables. Do not average them into one building rule.
body.zh: 电动40的 13 骨料是 40 m / 120 m，细石是 120 m / 360 m。电动50的 13 mm 石子是 80 m / 240 m，细石是 150 m / 350 m。电动低压60的 13 mm 是 100 m / 300 m。它们是不同的表。不要平均成一条建筑规则。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Mark the stone as aggregate 13 or fine stone before asking for a model. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 询盘前先标明石子是 13 骨料还是细石。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Is ≤ 3 cm the same as the aggregate-13 distance?
question.zh: ≤ 3 cm 是否等于 13 骨料那一档距离？

answer.en: No. ≤ 3 cm is the maximum-aggregate cell. The aggregate-13 distance is a separate row: 20 m / 60 m.
answer.zh: 不是。≤ 3 cm 是最大骨料格。13 骨料距离是单独一行：20 m / 60 m。

question.en: Does Electric 30 print an 80 mm pipe?
question.zh: 电动30印了 80 mm 管吗？

answer.en: No. The 80 mm pipe cell is on Electric 20. Electric 30’s published distance rows are the fine-stone and aggregate-13 pairs above.
answer.zh: 没有。80 mm 管在电动20上。电动30公布的是上面的细石行和 13 骨料行。

question.en: Can this row cover a high-rise label?
question.zh: 这一行能覆盖“高层”标签吗？

answer.en: High-rise electric pumping is the phrase on Electric 60, not on Electric 30. Stay inside 20 m / 60 m when the stone is aggregate 13.
answer.zh: “高层电动泵送”写在电动60上，不在电动30上。石子是 13 骨料时，停在 20 m / 60 m 内。
